import sys
from itertools import groupby

def main():
    input_str = sys.stdin.readline().strip()
    final_count = 0
    if input_str:
        seq_counter = 1
        for _, group in groupby(input_str):
            run = ''.join(group)
            seq_counter += len(run) - 1
            if seq_counter % 2 == 0:
                final_count += 1
                seq_counter = 1
    print(final_count)

if __name__ == "__main__":
    main()
